import json, os
REL = "../../examples/equivalence_source"

def show(fn, keys):
    d = json.load(open(os.path.join(REL, fn)))
    print("=" * 70)
    print(d.get("phase", fn), "--", d.get("description", ""))
    print("=" * 70)
    for k in keys:
        if k in d:
            v = d[k]
            print(f"\n[{k}]")
            if isinstance(v, dict):
                for kk, vv in v.items():
                    print(f"  {kk}: {vv}")
            else:
                print(f"  {v}")

# Phase 2: 1 MHz parallel-plate WPT harmonic (Cubit-coupled e2e -> committed result)
show("results_phase2.json", ["source", "reconstruction", "obs_results"])
print()
# Phase 3: end-to-end Cubit -> .vol -> NearFieldSource -> .sol (committed result)
show("results_phase3.json", ["mesh_source_kind", "cli_result", "projection", "verification"])
print()
# C++ kernel benchmark
show("results_bench_static.json", ["acceptance", "results"])
